name: Adobe Analytics
description: Adds Adobe Analytics javascript tracking code to your site's pages.
project_description: Adobe Analytics (formerly Omniture SiteCatalyst) integration for Drupal. The module injects the Adobe Analytics / AppMeasurement tracking script and its variable payload into the bottom of every non-administration page via hook_page_bottom() and a cache-context-aware lazy builder. Configuration lives at /admin/config/search/adobeanalytics: the path to the AppMeasurement JS file, the reporting version string, an optional no-JavaScript tracking image, a token cache lifetime, role-based tracking rules (inclusive/exclusive role lists), an arbitrary list of custom tracking variables (props/eVars) whose values accept Drupal tokens, and a free-form custom JavaScript snippet. Tokens in variable values and the snippet are replaced per request (node/term/user/menu plus global tokens). Other modules can contribute variables via hook_adobe_analytics_variables() (header/variables/footer sections). A per-entity override is available by attaching the provided 'adobe_analytics' field type to a bundle, letting an entity include or exclude the global variables and main snippet and supply its own snippet. Tracking is suppressed on admin routes and for non-matching roles through pluggable tracking matchers tagged 'adobe_analytics_tracking_matcher'.
